critical_code_review_comments: Forms.js isSigned() helper uses Object.values(f.responses).some(v=>v.startsWith('data:image')). This is efficient and matches server storage format. Consider narrowing to fields where template.type==='signature' to future-proof against non-signature fields that happen to accept image data URLs (e.g., a future 'photo upload' field-type).

FORM_TEMPLATES in server.py now has all 5 form-types with an appended signature field. As templates grow, consider moving them to a separate module or JSON file to keep server.py under 1000 lines (currently ~880).
The signed-badge only renders in the list view; consider also showing it in the Responses modal header for extra confirmation to staff (nice-to-have).
